id.description: Id of the related person (case/contact/event/contact of contact)

visualId.description: Visual (human readable) id of the related person

masked.description: True when the logged in user is not allowed to read this person, in which case the name comes empty

name.description: Event name (only populated when type is event)

firstName.description: First name (only populated when type is case/contact/contact of contact)

middleName.description: Middle name (only populated when type is case/contact/contact of contact)

lastName.description: Last name (only populated when type is case/contact/contact of contact)

classification.description: Classification (only populated when the related person is a case)

dateOfReporting.description: Date the related person was reported

dateOfOnset.description: Date of onset (only populated when the related person is a case)

followUpTeamId.description: Id of the follow-up team assigned to the related person
